question.title: Panels Clear of the Chimney Shadow
question.content:
You are given an m x n character grid roof seen from above, with the sun directly at the top edge. Each cell is one of:

  • 'S', a solar panel,
  • 'C', a chimney, or
  • '.', a bare tile.

A chimney shades every cell below it in the same column. Return the number of solar panels that no chimney shades.

 

Example 1:

Input: roof = [["S","C"],[".","S"]]
Output: 1
Explanation: The panel in the second column sits below the chimney, so only the panel in the first column counts.

Example 2:

Input: roof = [["C","S","."],["S","S","C"],["S",".","S"]]
Output: 2

Example 3:

Input: roof = [["S"],["S"]]
Output: 2

 

Constraints:

  • m == roof.length
  • n == roof[i].length
  • 1 <= m, n <= 300
  • roof[i][j] is 'S', 'C', or '.'.
